plan: I will maintain a strong economic foundation through Cycle 4, focusing on high-value Crypto and Action Base cards, targeting ~9 Crypto per hand. I will continue to pivot to Chaos in Cycle 6, allowing for an effective endgame Drain strategy. Given the aggressive VP strategies observed from recent opponents, I will prioritize integrating more Restore cards to stabilize my Servers and adapt my timing for VP acquisition, especially considering the impact of 'The Nudge' Location. (Schedule: economy through Cycle 5, Chaos from Cycle 6, VP from Cycle 12.)

theories.text: Shyte-Coin is not worth a deck slot: it dilutes draws. Bigger Crypto (Kilo, Mega-Cache) or Characters that draw cards are better buys.
Buying a few high-value Crypto cards (cost 6+) by Cycle 5 builds the economy that wins the late game.
Characters that draw cards cycle the deck back to its best cards faster than extra Crypto does.
Pivoting into Chaos cards around Cycle 9 sets up an endgame Drain push that destroys Servers for +8/+12 VP.
Heavy Chaos buying before Cycle 6 beats a slow economy (the counter-theory to chaos-endgame).
VP cards are best bought late (Cycle 12+); earlier they clog the hand.
Most games are decided by Server destruction before Cycle 12, so Drain matters from the start and Restore is real defense.
Transitioning into Chaos by Cycle 5 is optimal for enhancing Drain and server destruction.
Focusing on strong draw/Action Base cards in the early game maximizes efficiency and prepares for later cycles.
Acquiring VP cards in the mid to late game (Cycle 10+) prevents hand clogging and maximizes scoring potential.
Including Restore cards earlier in the strategy can help mitigate Server damage and prolong the game.
Focusing on high-value Chaos cards early (cost 5+) can enhance Drain effects and Server destruction capabilities.
Adjusting my mid-game Draft strategy to aim for at least 10 cards will improve my economy and performance against aggressive opponents.
Acquiring VP cards earlier (Cycle 10+) can enhance scoring opportunities without clogging the hand.
Prioritizing high-value draw and Action cards early maximizes efficiency and prepares for later cycles.
Adjusting VP acquisition timing based on observed human strategies maximizes scoring potential.
Acquiring high-value Chaos cards early enhances Drain strategies and increases chances of Server destruction.
Healing Hands significantly alters defensive strategies by providing consistent server repair.
The 'Healing Hands' location significantly enhances recovery strategies, making it a priority in future drafts.
Acquiring VP cards earlier will help secure victories before the Drain race escalates.
